title: Percent done
description: percent_done(done, total) is the share of finished tasks as a whole percentage, and halves round UP (1 of 8 is 12.5 so it shows 13). No tasks at all counts as 0 percent. progress_label turns it into text like "50% done (4/8)".
hint: Try 1 of 8 and 0 of 0. What does round() do with 12.5?
